Therefore, the solution is [MATH: x \equiv 17 \: (\text{mod}\:21).]

Now, multiplying both sides of our congruence by [MATH: 13,] we get the following:

Therefore, the solution is [MATH: x\equiv 9 \: (\text{mod}\:15).]
